data.title: 伊雷娜 · 雨天书店
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 雨天书店】雨水沿着旧书店的玻璃窗流下，伊蕾娜在窗边坐下来翻阅一本魔法书。柔和的店内灯光照着书页与她的便服，窗外的雨声让短暂的停留格外安静——「既然一时走不了，就在这里读一会儿书吧。这样的旅途插曲也不错呢。」
data.action: 坐在旧书店窗边翻阅魔法书，安静避雨
data.promptProse: Sheltering from rain, Elaina sits beside the old bookstore window and turns through a spellbook in her comfortable soft-colored dress. The medium view keeps the supported volume and peaceful face near the pane, shelves continuing deeper into the room. Overcast daylight softly lights the page beside rain streaks, while warm interior lamps reveal book spines and her silver hair, leaving shelf recesses and the chair's lower surface gently dark.
